sections.overview: Psednos barnardi is a small snailfish (family Liparidae) known from the northwest atlantic, off new england.
sections.identification: It has 39–41 dorsal soft rays, 47 vertebrae and black skin on the chin and lower jaw. P. andriashevi also has 47 vertebrae but 42 rays. P. anoderkes has 37 rays and 42 vertebrae.
sections.diet: The species account and original description do not report a species-specific diet.
sections.behavior: No behavior is described in the species account.
sections.reproduction: The reviewed species sources do not describe reproduction.
sections.ecology: The known records are sparse; the reported maximum is 3.4 cm standard length.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports it as not evaluated on the IUCN Red List.

sources.title: A review of the genus Psednos — Chernova (2001)
